conflicts.about: which square boss with rounded corners and a central bore the Intent lengthens by 10 mm, and so which 'nothing else changes' statement holds: pad-centre's topology ('only the square boss at the left end is lengthened') or pad-outer's topology ('unchanged except for the boss-front-right lengthening')
conflicts.stands: the left end boss: boss-left / pad-left / hole-left / fillet-left. Its end face is at x = -52.2884 before the edit and x = -62.2884 after. Its bore axis is at y 19.24, z -4.30 and runs along the length. envelope length becomes 123.817 mm. Settled by me (assumed), on four grounds. First, it is the boss measured on the BaseFeature as a near-square prism (14.738 x 16.279 mm) whose own axis is the length, so 'the length of the boss' has one meaning. Second, its end face is 173.875 mm2 against a roughly 240 mm2 rounded-square outline; the missing roughly 66 mm2 is a central bore of about Ø9.2, matching the Ø10 cones on axis (1,0,0), so it carries a central bore. Third, it is the part's extremity in the length, where a 10 mm increase moves no other feature. Fourth, every number on the front-right reading (its 45-53 deg axis, its x range, its 14.9265/15 offset) is an eye estimate off the renders, per the provenance (d) entry in not_defined, with no measured face pair behind it. The front-right boss stays exactly as imported.
conflicts.was_also_said: the front-right boss (boss-front-right / hole-front-right), on a bore axis of about 50 deg, direction (0.643, 0.766, 0), lengthened 10 mm along that axis. pad-outer's topology says this. In front.png (around x 775, y 365), right.png (around x 75, y 365) and iso.png (around x 447, y 560) it is the only rounded-square face whose bore is actually visible, so the user may have meant it. If so, the user corrects it at the Plan Gate, and the Plan would then need that boss's end-face plane and current length measured off the BaseFeature.

conflicts.about: SETTLED (1): which side stays fixed when the three flanges are lengthened by 5 mm
conflicts.because: Settled by me as instructed by the question. This reading is the one the envelope (lowest point z = -18.613) and the pad-top, flange-centre, flange-left and flange-right direction entries already agree on. It also keeps the mounting locations, which fix the part in its assembly, in place, as the Intent's 'keep its position' asks. No render shows which side moves.
conflicts.stands: The roof rises and the mounting levels stay where they are. The main plate moves from z 2.613..4.613 to z 7.613..9.613, carrying the rear flange, the two upper tabs and every hole in it, all unchanged in shape. The lower mounting plate stays at z -17.387..-15.387, the front intermediate plate at z -11.387..-9.387, and the lowest point at z = -18.613. The overall height becomes 42.2259 mm.
conflicts.was_also_said: These entries are withdrawn: pad-bottom against the top face (upper face z = -20.387), pad-lower (25 mm below the top face), step-lower (underside z = -22.387), step-front against the bottom face (z -15.387 to -20.387), flange-front against the top face (upper plate held), step-left and step-right as the walls of a dropping lower level, and pad-inner's 'lower plate stays' read together with an upper plate held fixed.

conflicts.about: SETTLED (2): the level of the ears ear-left and ear-right
conflicts.because: Settled by me. The ears are mounting locations, and the ear topology (z -8.737..-6.737) and the 8.65 mm to the bottom face agree with each other to 0.001 mm.
conflicts.stands: The ears stay where they are imported, ear plate z -8.737..-6.737 (top face z = -6.737), together with their walls x = ±170..172. Those walls are not lengthened.
conflicts.was_also_said: Withdrawn: flange-left and flange-right against the bottom face, which moved an ear top face from z -9.387 to z -14.387. z = -9.387 is not the ear's top face, and on the roof-rises reading nothing below the split moves.

conflicts.about: SETTLED (3): the height of the front wall flange-front (y -16.8219..-14.8219)
conflicts.because: Settled by me from the wall's face area of 3080 mm2 over its length of about 220 mm, which gives 14 mm, and from the front intermediate plate at z -11.387..-9.387.
conflicts.stands: 14 mm before the edit and 19 mm after, measured from the main plate top z = 4.613 to the front intermediate plate top z = -9.387 (after the edit z = 9.613 to z = -9.387).
conflicts.was_also_said: Withdrawn: flange-front height 20 mm → 25 mm. That figure measures to the lower plate top z = -15.387, which is not the plate this wall meets.

conflicts.about: SETTLED (4): the upper tabs, one pair described three times (tab-upper-2x, tab-top, tab-rear-4x)
conflicts.because: Settled by me from the z 16.613..18.613 plates that all three topologies share. top.png and iso.png show only two raised tabs, the ones over the square windows.
conflicts.stands: There is one pair of tabs, with top plates at z 16.613..18.613 before the edit. Measured from the main plate top z = 4.613, the underside is 12 mm above it and the top is 14 mm above it. The pair moves up 5 mm with the roof to z 21.613..23.613, unchanged in shape.
conflicts.was_also_said: Withdrawn: tab-upper-2x's '12 mm to the tab top', which is 12 mm to the underside, and tab-rear-4x's '16 mm from the bottom face', which would put the underside at z = -1.387. tab-top and tab-rear-4x are this same pair and are not a second or third feature to build.

conflicts.because: Settled by me. flange-centre's count is 3 and names the front wall and the walls x = ±162..164, the Intent names three flanges, and pad-top's direction already carries the rear flange unchanged.
conflicts.stands: It is not lengthened. It keeps its imported length and moves up 5 mm with the main plate it hangs from.
conflicts.was_also_said: Withdrawn: flange-rear length '5 mm longer than as imported'. That would make four lengthened walls against the Intent's three.

conflicts.about: Re-read of the renders for conflict 1: which side walls join the roof to the side mounting plates (the ears).
conflicts.from: front.png line work at both ends, read at 2.46 px/mm against the 380 mm length; iso.png end ears; the section listing quoted in the question
conflicts.stands: front.png puts the ears on walls at x ≈ ±168..±172, hanging from the main-plate level. This agrees with the question's sections, which show walls x = ±170..172 running from the main plate (z 3.26) down to the ear plates (z -11.387..-9.387). front.png's scale is 380 mm across about 933 px, so about 2.46 px/mm. At each end it draws an ear plate at about y 405 px, a wall at about x 95..105 px (x ≈ -170 mm) rising to the main-plate line at about y 375 px, and a separate wall at about x 105..112 px (x ≈ -164 mm) dropping to the lower level at about y 425 px. That makes the ears about 12 mm below the main-plate top, against 11.35 mm (4.613 to -6.737) in the base part. iso.png shows the same: the end ear plates with their small holes are bent off the main plate's ends, not off the front corner tabs. So the walls x = ±162..164 join the front corner tabs to the lower plate and never meet the roof. On this reading the three flanges are the front wall (y -16.82..-14.82) and the two walls x = ±170..172. The walls x = ±162..164 and the corner tabs keep their imported length.
conflicts.was_also_said: Three entries said otherwise. flange-left, flange-right, flange-centre and step-left/step-right name x = ±162..164 as the lengthened walls. 'SETTLED (2)' says the walls x = ±170..172 are not lengthened and the ears stay put. 'SETTLED (1)' says the roof rises 5 mm while every mounting level stays put. Together these would lift the ears with the roof through unlengthened walls, or detach them.

conflicts.about: Re-read of the renders for conflict 2: the height of the front wall (flange-front / step-front, y -16.8219..-14.8219) before the edit.
conflicts.from: right.png vertical wall at about x 425 px between the main-plate line and the lowest plate, read at about 5.4 px/mm against the 168.356 mm depth; the section listing quoted in the question
conflicts.stands: right.png draws this wall as one vertical run from the main plate down to the lowest plate, not to the intermediate plate. The wall is at about x 420..430 px, running from the main-plate line at about y 362..370 px down to the bottom plate at about y 470..478 px. right.png's scale is 168.356 mm across about 910 px (x 65..975), so about 5.4 px/mm. The run is about 108 px, about 20 mm, which is the 4.613 → -15.387 distance. This agrees with the question's section at y = -15.8 (z -16.01 to 3.28). The wall is 20 mm before the edit and 25 mm after.
conflicts.was_also_said: 'SETTLED (3)' gives 14 mm → 19 mm, measured to the intermediate plate at z -9.387, and flange-front's length gives 19 mm. flange-front's height (20 → 25 mm) and the question's section agree with the render.

conflicts.about: SETTLED (6): which three walls are 'the 3 flanges' of the Intent
conflicts.because: Settled by me as the question instructed, off the question's slice of the BaseFeature. The walls x = ±162..164 run z -13.387..2.613 at y -75.822..-21.822 and do not meet the roof, so lengthening them cannot raise the enclosure. Only the front wall and the walls x = ±170..172 join the roof to a mounting level. front.png's ends, as in 'Re-read for conflict 1', show the same.
conflicts.stands: The three flanges are the front wall y -16.8219..-14.8219 (flange-front / step-front, one wall) and the two ear walls x = ±170..172 (flange-outer-left, flange-outer-right). Each is lengthened 5 mm in the height. The walls x = ±162..164 and the front corner tabs they carry keep their imported length and position.
conflicts.was_also_said: Withdrawn as criteria: flange-left, flange-right, step-left and step-right as lengthened walls; flange-centre's topology naming x = ±162..164; and SETTLED (2)'s 'the walls x = ±170..172 are not lengthened'. The ears themselves still stay where they are imported, as SETTLED (2) says.

conflicts.about: SETTLED (7): what moves with the roof
conflicts.because: Settled by me: these features meet no mounting level, so the lengthened walls carry them with the roof. This follows SETTLED (1) and SETTLED (5).
conflicts.stands: Under SETTLED (1) the roof rises 5 mm. Everything that hangs only from it and ends free moves up 5 mm unchanged in shape: the two upper tabs, the rear flange y 82.1781..84.1781 (down to z -9.387 before the edit), the central rear feature pad-rear (x -46..46, y 48..77, down to z -7.387), and every hole in the roof. Nothing below the three lengthened walls moves: the lower plate, the corner tabs with the walls x = ±162..164, and the ears.
conflicts.was_also_said: flange-rear → length: '5 mm longer than as imported' (already withdrawn by SETTLED (5)).

conflicts.because: Settled by me off the question's slice (faces z -13.387..0.613, wall from the roof to the lower plate) and right.png's single vertical run from the main plate to the lowest plate ('Re-read for conflict 2').
conflicts.stands: flange-front → length (14 → 19 mm) and flange-front → height (20 → 25 mm) describe the same wall, measured two ways. 14 mm is its flat face between the bends, z -13.387..0.613. 20 mm runs from the roof top z = 4.613 to the lower plate top z = -15.387. Both grow by 5 mm. The wall's lower end at the lower plate stays where it is, and its upper end rises with the roof to z 9.613 (roof top).
conflicts.was_also_said: SETTLED (3)'s measurement to the intermediate plate at z -9.387. Also dropped from what the Plan must satisfy, as already withdrawn by SETTLED (1): step-front against the bottom face (z -20.387), pad-bottom against the top face, pad-lower, and step-lower, each of which moved the lower plate down.

conflicts.stands: The views show at least 21 through openings in the part as imported, and the intent says to leave all of them unchanged. They are: the Ø50 hub bore (hole-bottom), seen open in the top view and in the iso view. The 10 flange bolt holes (hole-outer-10x) and the 2 small flange holes (hole-top-outer-2x), white (open) in the top view and open on the flange face in the iso view. The 4 cage windows (cutout-centre-4x), two each in the front and right views and seen through in the top and iso views. The 4 radial lug holes (hole-upper-4x), one each in the front and right views, white, so they go through. The imported BaseFeature's own count of 24 also covers the small ledge holes, which the renders cannot show as through or blind. This edit only replaces two edge treatments on the hub's bottom face, so it adds or removes no through feature. The count after the edit is therefore the base part's own count, 24.
conflicts.was_also_said: an acceptance criterion of 1 through feature. No sheet prints this number. It most likely came from the description's not_defined note saying the through-feature check on this edit 'concerns hole-bottom and the two hub-end fillets only'. That note limits what this edit may touch. It is not a count of the part's through features, and it should not be read as one. No Step should fill a hole or window to reach 1.

conflicts.about: which blend is 'the blend on the peninsula' that the Intent resizes from 18 mm to 14 mm
conflicts.stands: the rounded end of the peninsula's tip. The peninsula is the arm that runs out from the large concave sweep to the ear with the small hole: it is at top right in top.png, at middle right in front.png's close-up and at right in iso.png. All three draw its end as one convex rounded end around the small hole. The end's radius is visibly larger than the hole's, by roughly 1.8 times. This is the about-R18 BSpline surface of the BaseFeature: centre at about (75.7, 137.4), which is 446.487 mm from the left end face and 403.966 mm from the front face, with a coaxial inner face of about R15 3 mm inside it. It joins the plate's outer skin, its inner skin and the straight side wall at y about 125.8 to 155.2. No other rounded end or transition on that arm is drawn in any of the four views.
conflicts.was_also_said: fillet-left and fillet-outer put the blend on the R18 surface at (-318.239, 97.8116), 52.548 mm from the left end face. That surface is the full tube wall around hole-left, not a blend. fillet-right places the blend 263.318 to 444.032 mm from the left end face, at the arm's root where it meets the R173 sweep, and no view draws a rounded transition there.

conflicts.about: fillet-right's axis and position against the peninsula tip drawn in front.png and iso.png
conflicts.stands: front.png draws the peninsula as an arm rising from the flat base toward the ear at its right end. The arm's lower edge turns up from the flat bottom through a rounded transition at about two thirds of the sheet width, then runs straight and sloped to the rounded tip around the small bore. iso.png draws the same rise. So the tip's rounded end lies in the arm's own inclined plane, and its axis is perpendicular to the arm, not parallel to the height. That matches the BaseFeature's Face23 drifting about 5 mm in x across its z span. top.png draws the tip as one rounded end around the small bore and nothing else round on that arm.
conflicts.was_also_said: fillet-right: axis parallel to the height, placed 263.318 to 444.032 mm from the left end face at the arm's root where it runs into the R173 sweep. fillet-left and fillet-outer: on the R18/R15 tube around hole-left at (-318.239, 97.8116), which no view draws as a blend.

conflicts.about: envelope → the shape of the outside
conflicts.stands: no feature carries the outer contour, so the outside of the part is whatever profile the envelope's overall sizes are padded into
conflicts.was_also_said: not_defined → 26 → what: The centre of the R14 peninsula-tip end after the edit, which is options (a) and (b) of the question. None of the four renders draws a centre mark, a dimension or a tangency callout for that end. They show the end before the edit only, as one rounded end around the small bore whose R13 wall and bore stay as they are, so they do not say whether the centre moves along the bisector of the side walls or stays at (75.7, 137.4) and cuts the ear tube. The views do rule out option (c): no other rounded feature on the peninsula is drawn as a radiused end, and the only rounded transition besides the tip is the bend in front.png where the arm leaves the flat base. That bend has no coaxial bore and no radius any view can check against 18. The Intent's 'change nothing else' plus the ear's unchanged R13 wall bounds the new end from inside, but it does not fix the centre.

conflicts.about: the R14 tip (fillet-right-outer) against the unchanged Ø26 wall of the tip's Ø20 bore (hole-centre)
conflicts.stands: hole-centre keeps Ø20 / Ø26 on its axis at 444.032 mm from the left end face and 404.441 mm from the front face, because the Intent says to change nothing else
conflicts.was_also_said: fillet-right-outer is R14 with its centre slid along the side walls' bisector from 446.487 / 403.966. The R13 wall already reaches 15.5 mm from the R18 centre, so the R14 face may cut into the bore's wall. Whether it does, and by how much, is to be measured on the Body. The user settles at the Plan Gate whether the centre should instead go on the bore axis.

A printed or sheet-measured source for any of the listed numbers. The four sheets are shaded renders with no callouts, no dimension lines and no text layer, so none of the numbers can be pointed at on a sheet. They come from three places, none of which is a sheet: (a) the_base_part, the imported STEP geometry of Body 'Body', and arithmetic on it. That covers its plane offsets, cylinder diameters, cylinder centres, bounding box, face area 14493.6 and volume 936975, plus differences such as 52.548 = -318.239 - (-370.787) and 745.321 = 374.531 - (-370.79). (b) The user's intent, which gives 18 and 14. (c) My own conjecture in conflict and not_defined prose, which nothing settles: R11 and Ø22 for a kept 3 mm wall, 'x -336..-300', 'y 115.8', and the counts 1, 2, 4, 8. The (a) values are geometry of the part being edited, not dimensions of a drawing. The (c) values are assumptions and are not values of the part. The only change to build is the intent's 18 → 14.

The centre of the R14 peninsula-tip end after the edit, which is options (a) and (b) of the question. None of the four renders draws a centre mark, a dimension or a tangency callout for that end. They show the end before the edit only, as one rounded end around the small bore whose R13 wall and bore stay as they are, so they do not say whether the centre moves along the bisector of the side walls or stays at (75.7, 137.4) and cuts the ear tube. The views do rule out option (c): no other rounded feature on the peninsula is drawn as a radiused end, and the only rounded transition besides the tip is the bend in front.png where the arm leaves the flat base. That bend has no coaxial bore and no radius any view can check against 18. The Intent's 'change nothing else' plus the ear's unchanged R13 wall bounds the new end from inside, but it does not fix the centre.
